narrative.northStar: The department notice board, made searchable
narrative.overview: CampusKart turns the corridor notice board into the interface. A walnut frame holds one cork sheet; listings are paper slips in category colours held by brass pins, with tear-off tabs at the foot. Red is the pushpin and marks the one next action; the AI writes its notes by hand in ballpoint blue. Screens are working tools, so layouts stay conventional and the world lives in materials, marks and one authored moment: buying tears a tab off the slip and puts the seller's number in your hand.
keyCharacteristics: Framed sheet: walnut bar and L-frame around one cork board
Pushpin red for the one next action only
AI output handwritten in ballpoint blue
The tear-off tab as the signature interaction

rules.name: The Pushpin Rule
rules.body: Red appears once per screen, on the action that moves the deal forward.

rules.name: The Pen Rule
rules.body: Blue means the AI said it. Nothing else is blue except the focus ring.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Category is told by paper colour, never by emoji or tinted icon boxes.

rules.name: Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Archivo and Caveat only; monospace for literal SQL.

rules.name: Border or shadow, never both
rules.body: Paper has a shallow shadow; strips on paper use a tone step.

dos: Do put the screen's one finding first, with its red action beside it.
Do write every AI output in the pen.
Do use the category paper colour wherever a listing appears.
Do keep figures tabular and right-aligned in tables.
Do keep the tear-off as the only authored animation.
donts: Don't use red for anything but the next action.
Don't use emoji or tinted icon boxes for categories.
Don't add eyebrows, gradients, glass or glowing buttons.
Don't animate content in on page load.
Don't set titles above 32px or figures above 40px on working screens.
